name: status-page
description: Self-hosted status page with monitoring, incidents and an admin API.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @status-page/shared build && pnpm --filter @status-page/database build && pnpm --filter @status-page/api build && pnpm --filter @status-page/worker build && pnpm --filter @status-page/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @status-page/shared build && pnpm --filter @status-page/database build && pnpm --filter @status-page/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @status-page/worker typecheck && pnpm --filter @status-page/web typecheck
